record.statement: A D20 test succeeds when the d20 roll plus relevant modifiers meets or exceeds its target. Ability checks and saves use a Difficulty Class; attacks use Armor Class.

locators: D&D 5.2.1 SRD: Playing the Game — D20 Tests (pp. 6–7) (dnd-srd-5.2.1#000)

interpretation.defaultDialReason: Default to a single roll against a fixed target; a world can adjust target-setting to make challenges more or less demanding, reflecting their circumstances.
